description: This file defines the interface and data structures for the SPI (Serial Peripheral Interface) driver in an AUTOSAR-based embedded system, including configuration structures, enums, macros, and function prototypes.

methods.name: Spi_Init
methods.description: Initializes the SPI driver with the provided configuration.

methods.name: Spi_DeInit
methods.description: De-initializes the SPI driver, releasing resources.

methods.name: Spi_WriteIB
methods.description: Writes data to an internal buffer for a specified channel.

methods.name: Spi_AsyncTransmit
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous transmission of a sequence.

methods.name: Spi_ReadIB
methods.description: Reads data from an internal buffer for a specified channel.

methods.name: Spi_SetupEB
methods.description: Sets up an external buffer for transmission.

methods.name: Spi_GetStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the SPI driver.

methods.name: Spi_GetJobResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of a specific SPI job.

methods.name: Spi_GetSequenceResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of a specific SPI sequence.

methods.name: Spi_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Provides version information of the SPI module.

methods.name: Spi_SyncTransmit
methods.description: Performs a synchronous transmission of a sequence.

methods.name: Spi_GetHWUnitStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of a specific hardware unit.

methods.name: Spi_SetAsyncMode
methods.description: Sets the asynchronous mode for SPI communication.

methods.name: Spi_MainFunction_Handling
methods.description: Main handling function for SPI driver.

methods.name: Spi_MainFunction_Driving
methods.description: Main driving function for SPI driver.
